To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a resource bounded information gathering agent can use a planning and scheduling approach to effectively gather information from a large and heterogeneous set of information sources; (2) the agent can effectively use the information gathered from the information sources and its own knowledge base to resolve conflicts and inconsistencies in the gathered data; (3) the agent can reason about its own performance to determine the most appropriate information gathering approach to take.

(1) an information gathering agent can effectively use the information it gathers to refine its search activities, and (2) an information gathering system can effectively use an information gathering agent to support the information needs of a decision process

(i) the use of a resource-bounded information gathering agent that plans, reasons, and extracts information is a viable approach to effective information gathering; (ii) an agent that uses a variety of information sources and exploits the structure of documents to gather information is more effective at information gathering than a traditional agent that uses only one source;
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an information gathering agent that plans, reasons, learns, and acts in an information-rich environment.

developing a general information gathering architecture and associated algorithms that will allow the agent to reason about the tradeoffs involved in gathering information from a variety of information sources, including both unstructured and semi-structured documents.
developing a system that can autonomously gather information from the NII to satisfy a user's information needs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

BIG is a resource bounded information gathering agent that is capable of planning to gather information, reasoning about the tradeoffs associated with different gathering strategies, extracting information from unstructured documents, and using the extracted information to guide its information gathering and processing activities.
this paper describes a system that integrates many areas of research under a single umbrella.
BIG is the best information gathering agent ever developed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed and implemented a prototype system, BIG, that integrates several areas in AI under a single research agenda.
we have developed an integrated system that can gather information from the WWW, process it, and reason about its results.
we have developed an integrated system that is capable of planning, executing, and evaluating information gathering activities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the design of a next generation intelligent information agent must integrate a number of AI research areas under a common research umbrella.
a system that can effectively gather, process, and interpret information on the WWW must be able to reason about the tradeoffs of alternative approaches to the gathering process.
it is possible to integrate a wide variety of AI technologies to create an effective, robust, and scalable agent that can perform information gathering tasks on the NII.
